name: breeches
_design_note: F1-20 light legs slot. Lowest-tier leg covering — quilted hose. Covers cloth_leggings, padded_leggings from legacy data.
lore_template: A pair of quilted {material_name} breeches, cut full at the thigh and narrow at the calf. The padding turns a glancing edge more often than anyone expects, and it keeps the knees whole on a stone floor.
